name: flowrail
description: Deterministic Execution & Mutation State-Machine for AI Coding Agents

interface.shortDescription: Deterministic flow slicing and mutation state-machine
interface.longDescription: Deterministic Execution & Mutation State-Machine for AI Coding Agents. Slices codebases into isolated Business Flow Corridors (for reading) and Topological Mutation Plans (for writing), enforcing contract verification and blast-radius fencing at every boundary gate.
capabilities: Real-time blast radius fencing & contagion barriers
Typo-tolerant symbol discovery & in-memory corridor search
defaultPrompt: Discover entrypoints and inspect a business flow corridor with Flowrail.
Plan a safe topological mutation corridor and fence blast radius before modifying code.
Run Flowrail Doctor to audit codebase topology and semantic health.
